caption: The drawing depicts a single, elaborately decorated shoe with a low wooden heel and an upturned, curled toe. The shoe is divided into multiple colored sections: the heel area is dark blue or black, the midsection is a deep red, and the front is also dark blue or black. A decorative yellow-gold zigzag trim separates the heel and midsection, and there is additional yellow and gold ornamentation on the upper edge and front, including a row of small circular gold shapes resembling buttons or coins. The shoe features a vertical lace-up closure with dark laces that are threaded through round eyelets set along the yellow zigzag trim and tied with a bow, from which two multicolored tassels hang down. There are further white and pink curving lines and small dot decorations on the front portion of the shoe. The overall composition is centered, with the shoe shown in profile on a neutral, cream-colored background.
title: Man's Dancing Shoe
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
